exposure: Human umbilical cord stem cells (HUMSC) administration
outcome: Collagen expression in the anterior vaginal wall
cohort: The study included 40 healthy, ovariectomized, virgin female Winstar rats aged 8-12 weeks, weighing 18-22 grams.
finding: Administration of HUMSC resulted in a significant increase in collagen expression in the anterior vaginal tissue of postmenopausal female rats.
